claim: AAAI-27 Main Track submissions are limited to 7 pages of main technical content, with a maximum total length of 9 pages; any pages beyond page 7 are reserved exclusively for references and the reproducibility checklist.
scope_conditions: AAAI-27 Main Technical Track, regular paper submissions
quoted_support: Submissions are limited to 7 pages of main content, with a maximum total length of 9 pages. Any pages beyond page 7 are reserved exclusively for references. ... Submissions may consist of up to 7 pages of technical content plus additional pages solely for references and the reproducibility checklist.

claim: All AAAI-27 authors must complete a reproducibility checklist from the Author Kit and submit it separately from the main paper at submission time; claims that code/data 'will be released after acceptance' are not treated as evidence of reproducibility.
quoted_support: Claims that such materials 'will be released after acceptance or publication' must not be treated as evidence of reproducibility; if they are not included in the submission, reviewers should assume they will not be made available.

claim: AAAI-27 key deadlines: OpenReview submission site opens June 30, 2026; abstracts due July 21, 2026; full papers due July 28, 2026; supplementary material and code due July 31, 2026; Phase 1 rejection notification September 24, 2026; final acceptance/rejection notification November 30, 2026; camera-ready December 14, 2026; conference held February 16-23, 2027 in Montreal, Canada.
scope_conditions: All deadlines anywhere-on-earth (UTC-12); Main Technical Track
quoted_support: July 21, 2026 Abstracts due at 11:59 PM UTC-12 / July 28, 2026 Full papers due at 11:59 PM UTC-12 / July 31, 2026 Supplementary material and code due by 11:59 PM UTC-12

claim: AAAI-27 uses a two-phase review process where Phase 1 combines two human reviews with one AI-generated non-decisional supplementary review, and explicitly states no human reviewers or decisions are being replaced by AI.
stance_target: AAAI-27 review process structure and AI-assisted review pilot
scope_conditions: AAAI-27 AI-Assisted Peer Review Pilot, continuing from AAAI-26
quoted_support: the human-written reviews in Phase 1 will be complemented by an additional AI-generated review (as a uniquely identified AI-generated Supplementary First-Stage Review)... No human reviewers are being replaced by AI reviewing. No human decision making is being replaced by AI decision making.
numbers: 2 human reviews + 1 AI review in Phase 1

claim: AAAI-27 caps submissions at 10 per author across Main/AI-Alignment/AI-for-Social-Impact tracks and applies a substantial novelty check against other submissions with overlapping authors, with desk-rejection risk for near-duplicate 'lottery ticket' submissions.
quoted_support: AAAI will, as in previous years, limit the number of submissions that authors may submit simultaneously to 10 submissions. In addition, for AAAI-27, the review process will include a substantial novelty check with respect to other submissions involving any overlapping authors.
